product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native operating system for banks to automate operational workflows, monitor customer activity in real time, and develop financial products.
product_one_liner.notes: The description explicitly identifies an AI-native operating system for banks and specifies workflow automation, real-time customer visibility and financial-product development. Source: https://www.emprisebank.com/about/news/emprise-bank-selects-maximum-to-power-its-next-generation-of-banking-infrastructure.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers Request access and has no pricing link in its navigation or footer; checking /pricing did not produce a public pricing page. Source: https://maximum.com/.

named_customers.notes: Two qualifying customer names could not be established. The closest announcement explicitly describes Emprise Bank as a design partner, which is excluded by the question's partner rule. No qualifying customer directory, case-study collection or Maximum-specific review listing was found to justify an empty-list answer. Source: https://www.emprisebank.com/about/news/emprise-bank-selects-maximum-to-power-its-next-generation-of-banking-infrastructure.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn profile for the banking company reports an employee count of 11, placing it in 11-20. LinkedIn-associated headcount may differ from payroll headcount. Source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/maximum/.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly names Miami as its headquarters city. Source: https://dealroom.co/companies/maximum. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as Miami, United States. Source: https://dealroom.co/companies/maximum.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook reports 2025, consistent with the founder's Maximum role beginning in 2025. The company LinkedIn page instead lists 2026, so the year is not unanimous. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/1474291-54 and https://linkedin.com/in/randyfernando.

eng_blog.notes: No actual company blog was found: /blog serves homepage-style content, while the newsroom lists external press and investor coverage. Under the rule that no blog at all means unknown, this remains null rather than false. Sources: https://maximum.com/blog and https://maximum.com/newsroom.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link. Checks of the docs and help subdomains did not yield public documentation. Source: https://maximum.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Senior Staff Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; using AI coding agents within these roles does not qualify. Source: https://maximum.com/careers.

model_provider.notes: No model or provider was publicly identifiable in the inspected product content, security material, privacy-provider disclosures or press coverage. The privacy policy describes service providers generically, and public documentation was not found. Sources: https://maximum.com/privacy and https://maximum.com/.

compliance_certs.notes: The readable privacy policy describes security safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS. This is an empty disclosure list, not a claim that Maximum lacks certifications. Source: https://maximum.com/privacy.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company financing profile explicitly labels the latest deal Seed. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/1474291-54. | funding_date: The latest financing table dates the seed round August 3, 2026, giving 2026-08 in the requested format. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/1474291-54. | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook identifies the latest financing as a $30 million seed round, also announced by Maximum. The amount converts to USD 30,000,000. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/1474291-54 and https://linkedin.com/company/maximum.

raised_18mo.notes: The completed August 3, 2026 seed financing falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/1474291-54.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable careers page lists only three software-engineering titles, with no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening. Source: https://maximum.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum's August 3, 2026 public introduction falls inside the six-month window and qualifies as an introducing/announcing item under the supplied rule. This refers to the public launch announcement, not verified general availability. Sources: https://www.americanbanker.com/news/new-fintech-maximum-aims-to-take-on-the-core-banking-cabal and https://linkedin.com/company/maximum.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The founder's profile places his CEO role before the window. No dated qualifying appointment or departure was verified, and no complete, checkable leadership roster was available; therefore false cannot be established. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/randyfernando.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable careers page contains detailed engineering responsibilities and tool-use expectations, but names no CRM or sales/marketing system. Source: https://maximum.com/careers.
